L3 useTranslation import -> replaced by an inline English-default t(key, fallback) (no i18next provider in native).
L4 lucide-react icons (Home, Car, BatteryCharging, HeartPulse, MapPin) import -> dropped; native ships no SVG icon set, so each tab carries a text glyph (⌂ 🚗 ⚡ ♥ 📍).
L5 cn import -> dropped; Tailwind class composition replaced by StyleSheet + dynamic style arrays.
L6 LucideIcon type import -> dropped; the Tab.icon field becomes a `glyph` string.
L8-13 Tab interface -> preserved as a native Tab interface, with `icon: LucideIcon` swapped for `glyph: string`; path/i18nKey/fallback kept verbatim.
L15-19 TABS doc comment (top-5 routes, Dashboard→Drives→Charging→Battery→Map) -> preserved and extended with the glyph legend.
L20-26 TABS array -> preserved with identical paths, i18nKeys, and fallbacks; each lucide icon mapped to its glyph stand-in.
L28-29 BOTTOM_TAB_PATHS exported Set -> preserved verbatim (TABS.map(t => t.path)).
L31-33 BottomTabBar() + useLocation()/useTranslation() -> function preserved; useLocation -> currentPath prop, useTranslation -> inline t(); added onNavigate/bottomInset/style/testID native props.

L62 <Icon h-5 w-5 + active drop-shadow glow> -> AppText glyph fontSize 20 with active textShadow glow; marked accessibilityElementsHidden (decorative).
L63-65 <span text-[10px] font-medium leading-tight> label -> AppText fontSize 10 / lineHeight 12 / semibold weight, tinted to match the active state.
L66-68 active underline indicator (absolute -bottom-0.5 h-0.5 w-4 rounded-full accent + shadow) -> absolutely-positioned 16x2 accent View with 999 radius, rendered only when active.
L69-74 closing PrefetchLink/map/nav/function -> mirrored by the Pressable/map/View close; added BottomTabBar.displayName and a default export for native ergonomics.

Behavior, state names (currentPath/isActive), route paths, i18n keys, and visual intent (accent active highlight, glow, underline indicator) preserved. No DOM, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI imports.
